title: Eliminate legacy runtime and backwards-compatibility support
summary: SiloMath Android supports only the current approved V6 runtime and current local schema. Historical Android/Room compatibility is not required because there are no Production users or Production local datasets requiring preservation.
approved_delta: Remove legacy Android/Room entities, tables, DAOs, repositories and runtime compatibility paths not required by current V6 functionality.
Remove Long-to-UUID shims, legacy_* compatibility fields and historical Room migration paths.
Remove tests whose sole purpose is upgrading unsupported historical Android installations.
Create the current canonical V6 local schema directly for fresh installations.
Preserve current V6 offline-first, persistence and synchronization behavior.
Do not remove PostgreSQL/Supabase migration history required by the current canonical backend without separate approval.
